title: Cucumber and Basil Margarita Twist
ldKeywords: non-alcoholic margarita, cucumber basil mocktail, alcohol-free cocktail, Lyre's Agave Blanco, tequila alternative, lime, basil, cucumber
ldInstructionsRaw: Gently muddle the cucumber and basil leaves in a cocktail shaker.
Add Lyre's Agave Blanco, fresh lime juice and sugar syrup.
Fill the shaker with ice and shake briefly to chill.
Fine strain into a rocks glass filled with fresh ice.
Garnish with a cucumber ribbon, basil sprig and a lime wheel. Optional: add a light salt rim.
